en.headline: Black Kite’s Flockfest brings craft beer and indie music to PMQ this weekend
en.dek: The three-day free-entry festival from 11 to 13 September features eight Hong Kong and Japanese breweries, more than 50 beers, local food and live sets by 15 indie acts.
body: Black Kite Brewery will stage Flockfest 2026 at the PMQ courtyard and marketplace in Central from Friday 11 to Sunday 13 September, bringing together craft beer, indie music and local food under the theme Brewing Beyond Beer.

Eight breweries from Hong Kong and Japan — including Black Kite, Yardley Brothers, hEROES Beer Co, Deadman Brewery, West Coast Brewing, Far Yeast, Black Tide and DD4D — will pour more than 50 beers across 20 taps, among them eight limited collaboration releases. Food stalls feature local operators such as Chin Teng noodles and Sonny’s Slice Shop pizza.

Live music is curated by LIKEWISE with 15 Hong Kong indie acts. Admission is free; drinks and merchandise packages are sold separately. Hours are 5pm–10pm on Friday, noon–10pm on Saturday and noon–5pm on Sunday. The organisers said the event is cashless.

zh.headline: 黑鳶Flockfest周末PMQ舉行 精釀啤酒與本地獨立音樂
zh.dek: 9月11至13日於中環元創方免費入場，匯聚港日八間酒廠逾50款啤酒、本地美食及15組獨立音樂單位。
body: 香港精釀啤酒廠黑鳶（Black Kite Brewery）將於9月11日至13日在中環鴨巴甸街PMQ元創方地面廣場舉辦Flockfest 2026，以「Brewing Beyond Beer」為主題，結合精釀啤酒、獨立音樂與本地美食。
活動匯聚香港及日本共八間酒廠，包括黑鳶、Yardley Brothers、hEROES Beer Co、Deadman Brewery、West Coast Brewing、Far Yeast、Black Tide及DD4D，提供逾50款啤酒及八款限定聯乘作品，另設本地食檔如真燈粉麵及Sonny’s Slice Shop薄餅。
音樂部分由LIKEWISE策劃，有15組本地獨立音樂單位演出。入場免費，飲品及周邊商品另購。開放時間為周五下午5時至晚上10時、周六中午12時至晚上10時、周日中午12時至下午5時，現場以無現金支付。
